## Overview

Remove `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/README.md`. It labels Model Runner V2 as "[Experimental] ... under active development", which is out of date now that MRV2 is the default GPU model runner.

## Claims

- Deletes a 4-line README that is out of date. There are no code or behavior changes.
- `docs/design/model_runner_v2.md` remains the canonical MRV2 design doc.

## Validation

- `grep -rn "worker/gpu/README"` finds no references to the file in the repo or docs.
- pre-commit passes.

## Details

Not a duplicate: I found no open PR that touches this file. #63305 is a stale-docs PR, but it doesn't modify `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/`.
